title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Gotta go to Greenfield Village with Sam. Any recommendation around Dearborn I should go for a bite to eat?
What are you in the mood for
Very open to anything that is nicer than Miller’s but not so nice that my wallet hurts. Think there’s an andiamo down there and that’s where I’d probably stop and say nothing nicer than this.
Dinner?
Yeah or some place I can go after 9:30/10 and still get good food
Does she like Mediterranean food
Yeah, she’s a fan (thankfully)
Ok
Al-Ameer
Sweet, I googled enough places and that was one I wanted to try.
Is Ford’s Garage overhyped like it seems?
I don’t know. I haven’t brought myself in to try it
I don’t know if it’s affiliated with Ford
But it looks like a Rams Horn with Model T’s
It’s closer to Greenfirld Village though
Yup, seems like it. I searched most reviewed places and that one came up every time. Don’t feel like going to some place that has mediocre food when there are so many good options around
Al Ameer was really good, I just forgot the name so I had to ask my friend
Sounds good. I’ll let you know if we end up going there or if Sam decides she wants she place different.
Worst case I’ll meet you in Dearborn soon and we can go there or somewhere else.
For sure
Have fun
